out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CORRECETD.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CORRECTED.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: ICE SCOOP observed laying on the ice, with handle in direct contact with the ice, inside the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CORRECTED. Scoop p[lace inside a cleaned stainless steel container, stored on counter, next to the ice machine.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Several squeeze bottles and bulk food containers holding sauces, syrups, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The unmarked bottles and containers were labeled properly, during the inspection. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Boxes of Single Service cups, lids, and containers, were found stored on the floor, in the dry storage room.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Utensils Maintained in Good Repair
violations.observation: The following utensil was observed in a state of repair and condition preventing effective maintenance and cleaning/sanitization: Two white rubber spatulas .
violations.corrective_action: Utensils shall be maintained in a state of repair or condition that complies with the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2 or shall be discarded. Discarded during the inspection. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS OBSERVED JUGS OF TEA ON FLOOR OF WALK IN COOLER, AND BOXES OF CANE SUGAR SYRUP AND NONDAIRY CREAMER ON FLOOR OF DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC WILL OBTAIN SUFFICIENT, APPROVED STORAGE FOR ALL FOOD ITEMS. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: BOXES OF SINGLE SERVICE CUPS AND BOXES OF SINGLE SERVICE STRAWS were found stored ON FLOOR OF DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. PIC WILL OBTAIN SUFFICIENT, APPROVED STORAGE FOR ALL SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
